instruction: Write an XDP/eBPF program that maintains per-flow packet and byte totals plus SYN, FIN, and RST observation flags for IPv4 TCP traffic in hash map 'tcp_flow_map' (type BPF_MAP_TYPE_HASH, key struct { __u32 saddr; __u32 daddr; __u16 sport; __u16 dport; }, val struct { __u64 packets; __u64 bytes; __u32 syn_seen; __u32 fin_seen; __u32 rst_seen; }, max_entries 32768). For each valid IPv4 TCP packet, construct 4-tuple key, lookup or insert entry in 'tcp_flow_map', increment packets (*val.packets += 1), add bytes (*val.bytes += wire_len), and set syn_seen=1 if SYN flag present, fin_seen=1 if FIN flag present, rst_seen=1 if RST flag present. Return XDP_PASS for all traffic.
requirements: Define 'tcp_flow_map' (type BPF_MAP_TYPE_HASH, key struct { __u32 saddr; __u32 daddr; __u16 sport; __u16 dport; }, val struct { __u64 packets; __u64 bytes; __u32 syn_seen; __u32 fin_seen; __u32 rst_seen; }, max_entries 32768)
Check Ethernet and IPv4 bounds, verify ip->protocol == IPPROTO_TCP
Parse variable IHL (ip->ihl * 4) and verify TCP header bounds
Lookup key in 'tcp_flow_map' or initialize new entry
Update packets, bytes, syn_seen, fin_seen, rst_seen
GPL license and SEC("xdp") entry point

tests.name: flow1_syn_pass
tests.description: Flow 1 SYN packet sets syn_seen=1 and returns XDP_PASS

tests.name: flow1_ack_pass
tests.description: Flow 1 ACK packet increments packets and bytes and returns XDP_PASS

tests.name: flow1_fin_pass
tests.description: Flow 1 FIN packet sets fin_seen=1 and returns XDP_PASS

tests.name: flow2_rst_pass
tests.description: Flow 2 RST packet sets rst_seen=1 and returns XDP_PASS

tests.name: udp_traffic_pass

tests.name: icmp_traffic_pass

tests.name: ihl6_flow_pass
tests.description: IPv4 TCP packet with IHL=6 options returns XDP_PASS

tests.name: truncated_tcp_pass
tests.description: Truncated TCP header returns XDP_PASS safely
